legend: Given a tree of n%%ZSMJ0%% vertices, each node is initially either black or white.
A path from node u%%ZSMJ1%% to node v%%ZSMJ2%% is:
white if both nodes u%%ZSMJ3%% and v%%ZSMJ4%% are white.
black if both nodes u%%ZSMJ5%% and v%%ZSMJ6%% are black.
otherwise it is a normal path neither white nor black.
A white path is clean if and only if there is no black path that contains this white path as a subpath of it.
A path is a subpath from another path if the set of vertices of this path forms a subset of the vertices of the other path.
The score of the tree is the number of Clean White Paths.
Note that path (u,v)%%ZSMJ7%% is the same as path (v,u)%%ZSMJ8%% and has to be counted once, and you have to count paths of the form (u,u)%%ZSMJ9%%.
Given q%%ZSMJ10%% update queries, in each query you are given an integer u%%ZSMJ11%%, make the node u%%ZSMJ12%% black.
After each query, print the score of the tree.
input: The first line contains a single integer t%%ZSMJ13%% (1≤t≤105)%%ZSMJ14%%, the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains two integers n%%ZSMJ15%% and q%%ZSMJ16%% (1≤n≤3×105)%%ZSMJ17%% (1≤q≤3×105)%%ZSMJ18%% , the size of the tree and the number of queries respectively.

The second line of each test case contains a binary string s%%ZSMJ19%% of size n%%ZSMJ20%% (si∈(0,1))%%ZSMJ21%% , if si%%ZSMJ22%% is 1%%ZSMJ23%% then the ith%%ZSMJ24%% node is white, otherwise the node is black.

The next n−1%%ZSMJ25%% lines describe the edges of the tree, each line contains two integers u%%ZSMJ26%%,v%%ZSMJ27%% (1≤u,v≤n)%%ZSMJ28%%, which means there is an edge between node u%%ZSMJ29%% and node v%%ZSMJ30%%.
Each of the next q%%ZSMJ31%% lines contains a single integer u%%ZSMJ32%% (1≤u≤n)%%ZSMJ33%%, the node to make black.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n%%ZSMJ34%% and the sum of q%%ZSMJ35%% over all test cases doesn't exceed 3×105%%ZSMJ36%%.
output: In each test case, after each query print the score of the tree.
note: After the first update, node 4%%ZSMJ37%% is black; all white paths are clean, so the answer is 10%%ZSMJ38%%.
After the third update, there are two clean white paths: (1,5)%%ZSMJ39%% and (1,1)%%ZSMJ40%%.
